Our marvelous mechanic Hibi is back again with more insights for aspiring racing pilots looking to find their perfect vehicle! For anyone who's unfamiliar with this enthusiastic Ardennian, Hibi is the engineer who upgrades Shade's vehicles and occasionally adds an experimental part or two to keep things interesting.

In the second episode of the Under the Hood with Hibi series, Hibi talks Shade through the features, benefits, and build possibilities of speeder bikes. Are you interested in racing the vehicles that Hibi affectionately describes as being "like concussion missiles with handlebars"? Watch the full episode to find out and check back soon for Episode 3.

STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ launches worldwide on October 6th. Pre-order today for PlayStation 5.

Widely celebrated as one of the most historically important countries for its contributions to art, culture, science, and modern civilization, Italy comprises some of the world’s most beautiful and noteworthy cities. Microsoft Flight Simulator City Update 16 highlights nine urban areas throughout Italy, ranging from the country’s north to its southern tip, including the islands of Sardinia and Sicily. The areas covered include coastal cities, inland metropolitan regions, and urban areas set to dramatic natural backdrops. 

Microsoft Flight Simulator City Update 16: Italy is available to all owners of Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) and Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 today for FREE. Ensure that you have the latest simulator version installed, download City Update 16, and explore the incredible sights of these beautiful locations throughout Italy! The sky is calling!

SUPERHYPERCUBE is out August 27th on PS VR2!

SUPERHYPERCUBE VR challenges you to rotate and grow your cluster of cubes to scrape through an ever-quickening gauntlet of tricky walls – a simple concept that tests your reflexes, calling you to pick it up again and again. One more run. One more wall. One more chance to beat your score.

Newly rebuilt for PlayStation®VR2, the PS VR launch day classic that captivated players a decade ago is back like never before. Sharper visuals extend the neon geometry further into the vibrant atmosphere. Full head and hand vibration heighten every acceleration and collision.  Plus, an expanded trophy set gives you and your friends new challenges to chase beyond the leaderboard.

Ten years on, SUPERHYPERCUBE VR still defines spatial arcade action. Play it now and find out why.
